<MethodEndpoint
  method={"put"}
  path={"/v1/account/{account}/flush"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Deletes all email indexes from Redis and re-creates the index for that account. You can only run a single flush operation at a time, so you must wait until the previous flush has finished before initiating a new one.<br/><br/>The request only schedules the work and returns before it finishes. Watch the account state, or the accountInitialized and authenticationError webhooks, for the result.
